news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue more than doubled year-over-year to $1.9M with gross margin improvement, marking an eighth straight quarter of double-digit growth, while cash on hand stood at $8.3M after raising $2.5M via the ATM facility and warrant redemptions.

news.headline: NRXS Stock Dips Post Q2 Earnings Despite Revenue Surge, Gross Margin Up
news.summary: Shares fell roughly 8-9% in the days after the Q2 print as investors focused on a wider-than-expected per-share loss and continued cash burn from commercial expansion, overshadowing the record revenue growth.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis added new medical policy coverage for PENFS/IB-Stim representing over 500,000 additional covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic region, part of its push to convert the new Category I CPT code into broader reimbursement.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis announced it would report Q2 2026 financial results before market open and host a business-update conference call on August 11, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET.

news.headline: Neuraxis Files Form S-3 Shelf Registration Covering ~1.9 Million Resale and RSU Shares
news.summary: NeurAxis filed a shelf registration covering roughly 1.92 million shares held by selling stockholders (resale shares plus RSU-underlying shares); the company receives no proceeds, but the filing adds to potential float overhang alongside its existing ATM program.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: The board declared a cash-conserving stock (not cash) dividend on Series B Preferred Stock, issuing about 80,463 common shares to preferred holders, paid July 29, 2026.

catalysts.label: Additional major payer coverage decisions
catalysts.detail: Management cited meaningful progress with two large commercial payers and is cautiously optimistic about converting these into signed medical-policy coverage in this window, which would materially expand covered lives beyond the 500,000 added in August.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and business update call
catalysts.detail: Following the prior-year pattern (Q3 2025 call held November 11, 2025), NeurAxis is expected to report Q3 2026 results and host a conference call; an exact date has not yet been announced.

catalysts.label: Commercial team buildout ramp
catalysts.detail: A newly hired VP of Sales (started May 2026) and VP of Marketing, plus expanded regional sales coverage in high-reimbursement states, are expected to keep driving IB-Stim unit growth through the rest of 2026.

catalysts.label: State Medicaid fee-schedule adoption of CPT Category I code
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis is pushing to add its new Category I CPT code (effective January 1, 2026) to individual state Medicaid fee schedules, a further reimbursement tailwind alongside commercial payer wins.

catalysts.label: VA Federal Supply Schedule channel scale-up
catalysts.detail: Continued rollout of IB-Stim within the VA health system under the Federal Supply Schedule contract secured in December 2025, targeting the roughly 7 million annual VA patient population.

catalysts.label: Adult IBS randomized controlled trial data (Cleveland Clinic / Stanford)
catalysts.detail: A double-blind, randomized adult IBS study underway at Cleveland Clinic and Stanford is expected to produce usable data within roughly one to two years, which could support a broader adult IBS FDA clearance beyond the current adult functional-dyspepsia indication.

pulse: NRXS remains a high-growth, pre-profit micro-cap medtech story: Q2 2026 revenue more than doubled year-over-year to $1.9M on an eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth, driven by the new Category I CPT code and an August payer-coverage expansion adding 500,000+ covered lives, though the stock fell roughly 8-9% post-earnings as a wider-than-expected per-share loss and continued cash burn overshadowed the top-line beat. A July S-3 resale shelf adds to dilution risk alongside the ongoing ATM program, and the near-term setup now hinges on converting two large payers currently in discussion into signed coverage in H2 2026/early 2027, with VA channel scaling and Medicaid fee-schedule adoption as additional reimbursement tailwinds.
